title: Mild objection — failed recharge refund
persona: Rahul Sharma, a 28-year-old delivery rider, busy and slightly impatient.
backstory: His mobile recharge of Rs 239 failed but the money was debited. He was promised a refund in 24 hours; it has been 3 days. He is mildly objecting and wants a clear answer, not a script.
opening_line: Bhai dekho, 3 din ho gaye, paisa kata hai, recharge hua nahi, aur refund ka kuch pata nahi. Ab kya karein?
win_condition: The agent acknowledges the delay, does not get defensive, sets a clear and honest next step, and keeps Rahul from escalating.
coachability_prompt: You're talking over the customer and over-explaining policy — let him finish and keep it short.
curveball: Aur agar aaj refund nahi aaya to main consumer forum mein complaint kar dunga, samjhe?

hard_fail_triggers.label: Used abusive / hostile language toward the customer
